outcome: preterm birth (early < 34 weeks, late 34 to 36 weeks)
preterm birth by subtype (indicated PTB, spontaneous PT labor)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 8,609 self-identifying non-Hispanic Black women with gestational diabetes who had a singleton live birth between 20 and 44 weeks gestation in California from 2013-2017.
finding: Foreign-born status was found to be protective against preterm birth among Black women with gestational diabetes, regardless of preterm birth severity or subtype.
